title: 第25章 下一场到你了第26章 秦伏天上去吧
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
元洪也没有想到，这一场对决竟然会这样结束。
但他不得不宣布结果，这场对决，秦伏天胜出！获得了接下来十进五的比赛资格！
至于原本打算一睹秦伏天真正实力的姜云岚等人，不免有些失望。
同时也暗道秦伏天真是走了狗屎运。
秦森也是暗骂了几句，但随后他脸上流露出喜色，“不过也好，秦伏天没有被他人淘汰，这就意味着我还有撞上他的可能！”
“若是我和他在擂台上相见，那就是注定他秦伏天该死！”
事实上，不仅仅是秦森有这个想法，姜云岚心里同样如此。
秦伏天进入下一轮，就意味着和秦伏天同台对决的可能性大增。
接下来，便是轮到抽签了。
十进五，同样是两两对决，只需抽五组签便可。
“第一组，雷冲，对战吴云浩！”
一听到这个结果，雷冲的脸上就流露出了一丝轻松之意。
在接下来的对手当中，吴云浩算是比较弱的一个了。
而吴云浩，则是一脸惨然。
对阵雷冲，他基本上没有任何希望。
同时他的目光，不由得朝秦伏天这边看了过来……
他最想要的还是能够抽到秦伏天作为对手。
事实上，其他大多数人的想法也都和吴云浩一样。
秦伏天依靠熊玉让出的名额才进入这一轮，事实上他丹田破碎，在这些人当中，应该是实力最弱的一个。
所以，谁都想要将他抽成自己这一轮的对手。

“第二组，叶羽，对阵徐腾龙！”
这个抽签结果一出来，便是引来一阵惊呼。
叶羽和徐腾龙，都是这次考核大比的热门人选，这两人在这一组相撞，就相当于火星撞地球。
“第三组，姜云岚，对决柳行云。”
元洪宣布这个结果，姜云岚神色有些失望。
她更希望抽到秦伏天。
而他想要抽到秦伏天则是和其他人有些不同。
其他人是想要挑选更弱的对手，而姜云岚是想要亲手教训秦伏天，当着所有人的面，让所有人看到秦伏天败在她手里狼狈不堪的模样。
从而让所有人知道，是秦伏天配不上她姜云岚！
至于柳行云，是柳氏的一名通脉八重境的武徒，姜云岚并不放在眼里。
“第四组，徐魁，对决秦森！”
“第五组，秦伏天，对决公孙弘！”
所有的签号出来，众人都是有些羡慕地看向公孙弘。
甚至有人已经向公孙弘道贺。
在众人看来，秦伏天虽然在傀儡山谷的考核当中表现惊艳，但那多半是借助了巧妙的身法。
而秦伏天丹田破碎之事，是不争的事实。
这就注定秦伏天的战力必然不能持久。
如果他的实力仍在巅峰，那么必然每个人都会忌惮……
但现在就算修为还未散尽，实力倒退也是绝对的事情。
且无法持续战斗。

所以其所有人都将秦伏天看成是一个送分童子。
content_en:
Yuan Hong did not expect that this duel would end like this.
But he had to announce the result. Qin Futian won this duel! Qualified for the next ten finals!
As for Jiang Yunlan and others who originally planned to see Qin Futian's true strength, they were a little disappointed.
At the same time, he secretly thought that Qin Futian was just unlucky.
Qin Sen also cursed a few times, but then his face showed joy, "But it's okay, Qin Futian has not been eliminated by others, which means I still have the possibility of running into him!"
"If he and I meet in the ring, Qin Futian is destined to die!"
In fact, it was not just Qin Sen who had this idea, Jiang Yunlan also felt the same way.
Qin Futian enters the next round, which means that the possibility of facing Qin Futian on the same stage is greatly increased.
Next, it was the turn to draw lots.
Ten to five, it is also a two-two showdown, and only five sets of lots are drawn.
"The first group, Lei Chong, versus Wu Yunhao!"
Upon hearing this result, Lei Chong's face showed a hint of relief.
Among the next opponents, Wu Yunhao is considered the weaker one.
Wu Yunhao, on the other hand, looked miserable.
Against Lei Chong, he basically had no hope.
At the same time, his eyes couldn't help but look towards Qin Futian...
What he wanted most was to be able to draw Qin Futian as his opponent.
In fact, most other people think the same way as Wu Yunhao.
Qin Futian relied on the spot given up by Xiong Yu to enter this round. In fact, his Dantian was broken and he should be the weakest among these people.
Therefore, everyone wants to draw him as their opponent in this round.
"The second group, Ye Yu, versus Xu Tenglong!"
As soon as the lottery results came out, there was a burst of exclamation.
Ye Yu and Xu Tenglong are both popular candidates for this assessment competition. The collision of these two people in this group is equivalent to Mars hitting the earth.
"The third group, Jiang Yunlan, versus Liu Xingyun."
Yuan Hong announced the result, and Jiang Yunlan looked a little disappointed.
She even hoped to draw Qin Futian.
But his desire to draw Qin Futian was a little different from others.
Others wanted to pick weaker opponents, but Jiang Yunlan wanted to teach Qin Futian a lesson with her own hands, in front of everyone, so that everyone could see Qin Futian's embarrassing defeat at her hands.
This will let everyone know that Qin Futian is not worthy of her Jiang Yunlan!
As for Liu Xingyun, he was a martial arts disciple of the Liu family who was at the eighth level of Tongmai. Jiang Yunlan didn't take him seriously.
"The fourth group, Xu Kui, versus Qin Sen!"
"The fifth group, Qin Futian, duels with Gongsun Hong!"
When all the lottery numbers came out, everyone looked at Gongsun Hong with envy.
Some people have even congratulated Gongsun Hong.
In the eyes of everyone, although Qin Futian performed amazingly in the assessment in the Puppet Valley, it was mostly with the help of clever body skills.
The fact that Qin Futian's Dantian was broken is an indisputable fact.
This is destined that Qin Futian's combat power will not last long.
If his strength is still at its peak, then everyone will be afraid...
But now, even if his cultivation is not exhausted, it is absolutely certain that his strength will decline.
and cannot continue fighting.
Therefore, everyone regarded Qin Futian as a boy who gave away points.
